metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with the field rule data embedded in [output/rules.json](/workspace/output/rules.json). I also added thin workspace launchers [main.js](/workspace/main.js) and [main.py](/workspace/main.py) so the requested `node main.js ...` and `python main.py --input ... --output ...` invocations work here.

What it covers:
- `inspect` and `inspect_marcxml` parse MARC ISO 2709 and MARCXML slim into the canonical JSON shape.
- `render_iso2709` and `render_marcxml` serialize the canonical record back out.
- It enforces UTF-8 decoding for field payloads, leader/directory structure, field repeatability, indicator values, and subfield codes.
- Malformed requests and malformed records return structured JSON errors with the requested codes.

Verified:
- `node --check` on the implementation
- ISO 2709 round-trip through render and inspect
- MARCXML round-trip
- `python main.py --input ... --output ...`

The core logic is self-contained in `output/` and uses only the Node.js standard library.
